name: Gluten
description: Found in wheat, barley, rye. Present in breads, pastas, cereals, baked goods.

name: Dairy
description: Milk, cheese, yogurt, butter. Present in cheesecake, lasagna, pizza, ice cream.

name: Eggs
description: Present in omelettes, baked goods, mayonnaise, some pasta and sauces.

name: Peanuts
description: Peanut butter, satay sauces, groundnut oil, some Asian dishes.

name: Tree Nuts
description: Almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, hazelnuts. Present in basbousa, konafa, desserts.

name: Soy
description: Soy sauce, tofu, edamame, soy protein. Present in sushi, spring rolls, Asian dishes.

name: Fish
description: All fin fish including salmon, tuna, cod. Present in sushi, grilled fish, tuna tartare.

name: Shellfish
description: Shrimp, crab, lobster, prawns, squid, calamari. Present in shrimp dishes, takoyaki.

name: Sesame
description: Sesame seeds, tahini, sesame oil. Present in falafel, hummus, sushi, pastries.

name: Sulfites
description: Preservatives in dried fruits, wine, processed foods, some salads.

name: Lupin
description: Lupin flour in gluten-free products, Mediterranean baked goods.

name: Mustard
description: Mustard seeds, powder, sauce. Present in dressings, sauces, some marinades.

name: Celery
description: Celery stalks, seeds, celeriac. Present in soups, stocks, some salads.

name: Crustaceans
description: Specific shellfish subgroup including shrimp, crab, lobster.
